purpose: Connect consented local keyboard, focus and optional pointer observations to the typed transition kernel without capturing content or claiming intent.

activities.label: observe local keyboard activity and active UIA context without retaining content
attack raw key title intent input injection camera screenshot and network boundaries
record the distinction between input observation and native state transition

queries.expression: can real local input activity and UIA focus context be observed without retaining content
does the observer avoid treating keyboard activity as intent before a native state delta exists
does the observer reject raw keys titles pixels camera network and injected actions
is consented input observation registered in the reproducible suite

assumptions: The existing low-level keyboard observer is opt-in and stores counts only.
The active UIA control type is context metadata, not user content or intent.
Pointer coordinates remain optional and local to the explicit experiment.
Semantic intent must remain false until an independent native state delta is observed.
The observer is read-only and does not authorize future actions.
kill_tests: Raw text and window titles are rejected.
Intent claims without native outcome are rejected.
unknowns: Whether a real human input event can be paired reliably with one native state delta under rapid interaction.
Whether UIA context is specific enough to route Excel and Blender events without document content.
Whether pointer and keyboard traces remain useful after privacy minimization.
Whether VIZZ gaze can add value as context without becoming an unverified intent oracle.
